goal: Allow kernel consumers to read all witness stack items in a single pass in linear time
Avoid the quadratic runtime penalty of repeatedly indexing serialized witness stacks
agreement: Objections settled and waiting on review of the revised API shape
Objected that processing items bottom to top treated the stack like a queue (ajtowns)
Addressed by replacing the callback interface with output arrays (ajtowns)
Suggested exposing witness stack serialization instead (yuvicc)

why: P3 because external kernel callers avoid an O(n^2) runtime penalty when reading full witness stacks
Provides an efficient linear-time traversal for downstream consumers reading serialized stacks
